title: Zindan may nahi aati
body:
zindan mein nahi aati kyun taaza hawa bhaiya
sajjad sakina ko marne se bacha bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
dewaaron se zindan ki takrake mai girti hoo
phir dayr talak bhaiya tanha hi sisakti hoo
aa rayt ke bistar se behna ko utha bhaiya
zindan mein nahi aati...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeeti thi imamat ke mai paak saveron mein
ab meri guzarti hai zindan ke andheron mein
is waqt bhi rassi mein hai mera gala bhaiya
zindan mein nahi aati...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani nahi mangungi bachon ko sambhalungi
in chote se haaton se tere kaate nikalungi
ek baar sakina ko tu paas bula bhaiya
zindan mein nahi aati...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne mujhe maara tha wo khaab mein aata hai
mai so bhi nahi sakti kuch aise darata hai
sajjad mujhe dedo baahon mein panaah bhaiya
zindan mein nahi aati...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad tere gham mein jo ashq bahayega
jo halqa e matam mein sar peet'ta aayega
tauqeer dilaungi waada hai mera bhaiya
zindan mein nahi aati...
author: Afzal Ajiz
